function combine<T>(callback: (a: T, b: T) => T): (a: T, b: T) => T {
  return callback;
}
const add = combine((a: number, b) => a + b);
const join = combine((a, b: string) => a + b);
const fromReturn = combine((a, b): number => a + b);
console.log(add(2, 3), join('a', 'b'), fromReturn(3, 4));

function evaluate<T>(fn: () => T): T { return fn(); }
let count = evaluate(() => 0);
count = 1;
let state = evaluate(() => 'ready');
state = 'done';
const context: 'expected' = evaluate(() => 'expected');
const explicit: 0 = evaluate(() => 0 as const);
function evaluateString<T extends string>(fn: () => T): T { return fn(); }
const constrained: 'keep' = evaluateString(() => 'keep');
console.log(count, state, context, explicit, constrained);

type IsNever<T> = [T] extends [never] ? true : false;
type Empty<T> = T[] extends never[] ? 1 : 2;
const yes: IsNever<never> = true;
const no: IsNever<string> = false;
const unknownResult: IsNever<any> = false;
const empty: Empty<never> = 1;
const populated: Empty<number> = 2;
console.log(yes, no, unknownResult, empty, populated);

function apply(kind: 'text', fn: (x: string) => void): void;
function apply(kind: 'number', fn: (x: number, y: number) => void): void;
function apply(kind: string, fn: any): void {
  if (kind === 'number') fn(2, 3);
  else fn('hello');
}
apply('number', (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y));
apply('text', (value) => console.log(value.toUpperCase()));
const prefix: ['number'] = ['number'];
const emptyArgs: [] = [];
apply(...prefix, (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y), ...emptyArgs);

function nested(value: { kind: 'text'; tuple: [(x: string) => void] }): void;
function nested(value: { kind: 'number'; tuple: [(x: number, y: number) => void] }): void;
function nested(value: any) { value.tuple[0](2, 3); }
nested({ kind: 'number', tuple: [(x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y)] });

function spreadCallback(value: { run: (text: string) => void }): void {
  value.run('spread');
}
spreadCallback({ ...{ run: (x) => console.log(x.toUpperCase()) } });
spreadCallback(true && { run: (x) => console.log(x.toUpperCase()) });
